node.title: When You Have to Decide Before You Can Discover
node.reading: The first article in this series said that projects to simplify, automate, or improve an organization fail for lack of information about how the work actually runs. The second said that much of that information was never decided — it has to be declared , and declaring it changes the process in the very act of asking. This article is about what that act costs, and the strange order in which the bill comes due.
node.readingSummary: The first article in this series said that projects to simplify, automate, or improve an organization fail for lack of information about how the work actually runs.

relations: A bounded provisional declaration can enable discovery without being mistaken for the binding ownership decision that the investigation is meant to inform.
No toda falta de información requiere declaración. La provisionalidad no autoriza efectos irreversibles ni elimina el coste de la decisión final.
A transformation business case should include the costs of looking, making binding declarations and absorbing their consequences, not only implementation expenditure.
No son tarifas ni porcentajes universales. Un esfuerzo de preparación real no es por sí mismo compensación evitable.
A focused intervention can begin with a bounded discovery mandate without confusing provisional assumptions with the binding decisions required for production change.
No activar una misión ilimitada con el pretexto de que todo se descubrirá después; la facultad de explorar no incluye todos los efectos.
Focus ON can distinguish an observable operating obstacle from a still-unmade declaration of ownership, scope or priority that the diagnosis cannot simply discover.
Se propone lectura metodológica, no uso histórico del paper posterior ni un algoritmo que determine la causa a partir de una entrevista.
A reversible provisional declaration can help discover a route between current and target states, while keeping exploration separate from an irreversible ownership or retirement decision.
Double-map deadlock permanece como constructo propuesto; no se demuestra incomputabilidad formal por la falta de un mapa.
A small, already-enabled intervention can be compared with bounded exploration, provided it is not mistaken for authorization to commit the full transformation.
Analogía de secuencia decisoria; no toda acción pequeña es reversible, suficiente o admisible.
For a complementary reading, see [Deciding before the architecture is fully known](https://tegrity.ai/when-you-have-to-decide-before-you-can-discover/).
For a complementary reading, see [Strategic framing and assumption validation](https://jubap.eu/reframing-value-creation/).
